findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: score_page_citation, local_ai_readiness, check_ai_instructions, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: audit_site, score_page_citation, audit_page, local_ai_readiness, check_ai_instructions, generate_ai_instructions · Public sink: check_ai_instructions, generate_ai_instructions, submit_feedback · Destructive: audit_site, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: score_page_citation, local_ai_readiness, check_ai_instructions, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: audit_site, score_page_citation, audit_page, local_ai_readiness, check_ai_instructions, generate_ai_instructions · Public sink: check_ai_instructions, generate_ai_instructions, submit_feedback · Destructive: audit_site, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
